verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de documents a broad public API covering its main UI services: notarization, incorporation, translation, tax registration and trade registration, plus webhooks. It never claims API/UI parity, and some UI features have no API evidence. Webhook URLs are registered via the dashboard rather than the API, and the Compliance API is limited to Enterprise plans. Missing for 10: an explicit parity statement, API endpoints for apostilles, identity verification and company-name availability checks, API-based webhook registration, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With Beglaubigt.de, businesses can submit documents, manage signers, and automate notarization workflows, or incorporate companies in Germany.
This endpoint creates an incorporation request for a company in Germany such as a GmbH or UG, including company details, shareholders, and directors.
This endpoint creates a translation request for one or multiple documents.
Register your webhook URL with Beglaubigt (via your dashboard under `/webhooks`).
